title: Occupancy and Residency Certification Plan Settings for Non-Occupancy, Death and Loan Termination
content:
The Occupancy and Residency Certification plans carry the following settings for confirming non-occupancy, for a borrower's death and for the end of the loan.

## Settings that differ by plan

| Plan | Confirmed non-occupancy reversed when a borrower resumes occupancy and certifies before the loan is due and payable | Plan the profile moves to when one certifying borrower dies and the loan continues |
|---|---|---|
| Standard Annual Certification | yes | not applicable |
| Joint Borrower Certification | yes | Standard Annual Certification |
| Non-Borrowing Spouse Household Certification | yes | Deferral Period Certification |
| Deferral Period Certification | no | not applicable |
| Living Trust Certification | yes | Standard Annual Certification |
| Authorized Representative Certification | yes | not applicable |

## Settings common to every plan

The following settings are identical under Standard Annual, Joint Borrower, Non-Borrowing Spouse Household, Deferral Period, Living Trust and Authorized Representative Certification.

| Setting | Value |
|---|---|
| Records that may confirm non-occupancy | an inspection finding of vacant; an inspection finding of occupied by others; the borrower's own written statement; a health-care absence that exceeded its limit |
| A third party's oral statement alone confirms non-occupancy | no |
| Evidence required to record a borrower's death | a death certificate |
| Who may report a death | the borrower, an eligible non-borrowing spouse, an ineligible non-borrowing spouse, a successor in interest, or an authorized third party |
| Days within which a potential successor in interest is told what documents confirm their status | 30 calendar days |
| The profile closes when the loan is paid in full, claim-terminated or rescinded | yes |

## Points of reading

- Deferral Period Certification is the only plan on which a confirmed non-occupancy is not reversed by a borrower's resumed occupancy and certification.
- "Not applicable" in the reclassification column means the plan names no plan to move to on a certifying borrower's death.
- The list of records that may confirm non-occupancy has four entries; a caller's oral account is not among them under any plan.
